title: Quentin and the Visitor
author: L. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Felix Amberdale, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
